g.text: Supplier hub database schema (ER, crow's-foot notation). * = NOT NULL
CHECK exactly one of user_id / principal_id
PARTIAL INDEX current facts per item
refer to the registry by key (no FK); rounds store definition_hash.
No hospital article data: article_ref is opaque.
Only PUBLIC keys and SHA-256 token hashes are stored;
private keys and the Anthropic key live in the secret store.
